attributes.storage_instructions: Store at room temperature in a clean, dry place. As this is a natural spread made without stabilisers, some oil separation is normal. Stir well for 1–2 minutes when you open the jar to restore its creamy texture. Refrigeration is not required, but if you prefer a thicker consistency, you may refrigerate the jar.
